blocker.message: Archived Savills LotList WARC captures can map legacy auction IDs to 2019 dates, but the catalogue-body parser recovered zero usable PID-bearing LotDetails links, so no older canonical lot can safely be persisted from this route.

repair_implemented_same_run.method: Query deterministic 2019 Common Crawl indexes only for the legacy LotDetails namespace restricted to already date-mapped aid values; accept only rows containing real pid values; then pass each candidate through surviving first-party Savills validation before History V2 persistence.
repair_implemented_same_run.safety: No PID, address, auction fact, or property fact is invented. The route is bounded to mapped legacy aids and retains the live Savills evidence gate.
repair_implemented_same_run.next_path_if_empty: Use only exact PID-bearing LotDetails URLs already observed in persisted Common Crawl samples/captures and retrieve those archived bodies individually; do not repeat broad /Auctions/ or LotList catalogue scans.
